title: Centering before Pruning: Lightweight Geometry Correction for Diversity-Based Visual Token Pruning in LVLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.30263v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) incur substantial inference costs due to their long and highly redundant visual-token sequences. Diversity-based pruning mitigates this cost by selecting token subsets based on pairwise cosine similarity. We find, however, that similarities between raw visual tokens are strongly concentrated in the positive range, limiting their ability to distinguish non-redundant tokens. A natural way to improve this resolution is to center token features before computing cosine similarity. Centering indeed reveals a substantially richer pairwise structure, yet unexpectedly degrades pruning performance when used alone. We show that this apparent contradiction arises because the raw geometry does more than represent pairwise diversity: it also implicitly favors globally distinctive tokens, which tend to contain semantically informative content. translated_title: 剪枝前先中心化：面向大型视觉语言模型中基于多样性视觉令牌剪枝的轻量级几何校正
translated_abstract: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）因其冗长且高度冗余的视觉令牌序列而产生高昂的推理成本。基于多样性的剪枝方法通过依据成对余弦相似度选择令牌子集来缓解这一成本。然而，我们发现原始视觉令牌之间的相似度高度集中在正数范围内，限制了其区分非冗余令牌的能力。提升这种分辨能力的一个自然做法是在计算余弦相似度之前对令牌特征进行中心化。中心化确实能揭示出更丰富的成对结构，但出人意料的是，单独使用时反而会降低剪枝性能。我们证明这一表面上的矛盾源于原始几何结构的作用不止于表征成对多样性：它还隐式地偏向全局独特的令牌，而这些令牌往往包含语义上信息丰富的内容。中心化虽能更好地解析子集多样性，却丢失了这一有用的令牌先验……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现对视觉令牌特征进行中心化虽能揭示更丰富的成对多样性结构，却会丢失原始几何中隐式偏向语义信息丰富令牌的先验，据此提出了一种轻量级几何校正方法以兼顾两者，从而改进大型视觉语言模型中基于多样性的视觉令牌剪枝。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that centering visual token features reveals richer pairwise diversity but loses the raw geometry's implicit bias toward globally distinctive, semantically informative tokens, and proposes a lightweight geometry correction that reconciles both to improve diversity-based visual token pruning in LVLMs.
